phrases.local:
Subject: Booking 23 Sep, Xie/Yuan — 4 guests, morning luggage storage

Dear Colectia Stays Gran Vía team,

We have a reservation for the night of 23 September 2026 under Xie Yongtong / Yuan Mingxin (booked via agency, order 454538630242). Our flight lands at MAD at 08:55, so we expect to arrive around 11:00, before check-in time.

Could you kindly confirm:
1. Can we leave 4 suitcases at reception around 11:00 until check-in?
2. We are 4 guests in total — Xie Yongtong, Yuan Mingxin, Jin Zhengyang and Chiu Yan Lui. Our confirmation shows only 2 guests; we believe there is a second reservation for the other two the same night. Could you confirm both bookings are in your system?
3. If a room happens to be ready earlier, we would happily check in before 15:00.

Thank you very much!

Best regards, [姓名] / [电话]

Asunto: Reserva 23 Sep, Xie/Yuan — 4 huéspedes, guardar equipaje por la mañana

Estimado equipo de Colectia Stays Gran Vía:

Tenemos una reserva para la noche del 23 de septiembre de 2026 a nombre de Xie Yongtong / Yuan Mingxin (reservada por agencia, pedido 454538630242). Nuestro vuelo aterriza a las 08:55 y llegaremos hacia las 11:00, antes de la hora de check-in.

¿Podrían confirmarnos:
1. ¿Podemos dejar 4 maletas en recepción sobre las 11:00 hasta el check-in?
2. Somos 4 huéspedes en total — Xie Yongtong, Yuan Mingxin, Jin Zhengyang y Chiu Yan Lui. Nuestra confirmación solo muestra 2 huéspedes; creemos que existe una segunda reserva para los otros dos la misma noche. ¿Pueden confirmar que ambas reservas figuran en su sistema?
3. Si alguna habitación estuviera lista antes, nos encantaría hacer el check-in antes de las 15:00.

¡Muchas gracias!

Saludos cordiales, [姓名] / [电话]

phrases.local:
Subject: Stay 4-6 Oct, Conf. 5210.508.440 — early luggage drop & early check-out

Dear Host,

We are the 4 guests staying at Unione Central Apartment from 4 to 6 October 2026 (confirmation 5210.508.440, PIN 9957).

Our train from Venice arrives at Milano Centrale around [时间], so we expect to reach the apartment around 12:30, before the 16:00 check-in. Could you kindly confirm:

1. Is there any possibility to leave our 4 suitcases somewhere before check-in (we are happy to pay a fee) — or even better, to check in earlier if the apartment is ready?
2. How does check-in work — will we meet someone, or receive self check-in instructions?
3. On 6 October our flight departs from Malpensa at 12:45, so we would need to check out around 09:00 — would early check-out be OK?
4. Could you confirm the exact amount due on arrival (balance + city tax) and whether we can pay by credit card?

Thank you very much!

Best regards, [姓名] / [电话]

phrases.local:
Oggetto: Soggiorno 4-6 ott, conf. 5210.508.440 — deposito bagagli anticipato e check-out anticipato

Gentile Host,

Siamo i 4 ospiti che soggiornano presso Unione Central Apartment dal 4 al 6 ottobre 2026 (conferma 5210.508.440, PIN 9957).

Il nostro treno da Venezia arriva a Milano Centrale verso le [ora], quindi raggiungeremo l'appartamento verso le 12:30, prima del check-in alle 16:00. Potrebbe gentilmente confermare:

1. C'è la possibilità di lasciare le nostre 4 valigie da qualche parte prima del check-in (siamo disposti a pagare) — o ancora meglio, fare il check-in in anticipo se l'appartamento è pronto?
2. Come funziona il check-in — ci verrà incontro qualcuno o riceveremo istruzioni per il check-in autonomo?
3. Il 6 ottobre il nostro volo parte da Malpensa alle 12:45, quindi dovremmo fare il check-out verso le 09:00 — va bene?
4. Può confermare l'importo esatto da pagare all'arrivo (saldo + tassa di soggiorno) e se è possibile pagare con carta?

Grazie mille!

Cordiali saluti, [姓名] / [电话]
